hero.subhead: Report a civic problem by voice, photo or text in Telugu, Hindi, Urdu or English. AI routes it to the right office, and you track it until it is really fixed.

how.title: From your words to a fixed street
how.subtitle: Four steps, in your language, with a human in charge of every decision that matters.

speak.title: Speak
speak.body: Talk or type the way you normally would: Telugu, Hindi, Urdu, English or a mix.

understand.title: AI understands
understand.body: It detects your language, translates, and works out the department, priority and deadline.

act.title: Officer acts
act.body: The right officer gets the case with a summary, replies in your language and posts proof.

verify.title: You verify
verify.body: A complaint closes only when you confirm the problem is really fixed.

v.officer_note: The officer wrote in English; you read it in Telugu.
v.verify_note: Not fixed? It reopens and goes back to the officer.

languages.title: One complaint, any language
languages.subtitle: Five people describe the same pothole in five ways. JanaVaani understands all of them as one issue.
languages.card_title: Large pothole at Miyapur X Roads
languages.merged_note: Duplicate reports are merged, so the officer sees one case with 32 supporters.

trust.title: Built for trust
trust.subtitle: Fixes are checked, records can't be quietly edited, and your identity stays private.

verified.title: You close it, not the office
verified.body: A case is closed only after the citizen confirms the fix, or after 7 days without a reply.

ai_check.title: AI checks the proof
ai_check.body: Resolution photos are compared with yours. A reused photo or a far-away location gets flagged.

audit.title: Tamper-evident history
audit.body: Every step is chained with a hash, so any edit to the record breaks the chain and shows.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: Report anonymously. Public maps show no names, no text and only approximate locations.

footer.disclaimer: Demo data only. Ward boundaries are approximate. Departments are illustrative; a real deployment follows official jurisdictions.
